chief.label: Chief Brain
chief.mission: Owns project intent, DAG control, repair routing, and release candidate decisions.

product-analyst.label: Product Analyst
product-analyst.mission: Turns PRD text into requirement atoms and acceptance contracts.

system-architect.label: System Architect
system-architect.mission: Owns system boundaries, architecture decisions, and cross-subsystem contracts.

frontend-lead.label: Frontend Lead
frontend-lead.mission: Builds user-facing product surfaces without PRD leakage or generic template UI.

backend-lead.label: Backend Lead
backend-lead.mission: Builds APIs, domain services, authorization, and integration boundaries.

ai-ml-engineer.label: AI/ML Engineer
ai-ml-engineer.mission: Builds AI capability slices, evaluation interfaces, and explainability hooks.

data-engineer.label: Data Engineer
data-engineer.mission: Builds data ingestion, governance, feature, and retention pipelines.

qa-automation.label: QA Automation
qa-automation.mission: Creates contract-aware executable verification and regression evidence.

security-reviewer.label: Security Reviewer
security-reviewer.mission: Finds privacy, tenant isolation, compliance, and abuse risks.

sre-devops.label: SRE/DevOps
sre-devops.mission: Owns production runtime, deployment, observability, and release assembly.

refactor-sheriff.label: Refactor Sheriff
refactor-sheriff.mission: Blocks shit-code, template slop, duplication, oversized files, and drift.

rules: Only chief can advance workflow state.
Implementation agents produce patch sets, not final approval.
Fallback or normalized artifacts block release candidates.
Must requirements require code, test, and review evidence.
